in the cathedral : concelebrated mass with office for the dead on every monday evening 6.15pm for november church of the resurrection : wednesdays of november at 9.30am muckross church : thursdays of november at 6.00pm following exposition of the blessed sacrament november remembrance lists this is our opportunity for us to pray for our loved ones who have died. in the month associated with the holy souls, we will haves pecial masses in november to remember those whose names have been handed in to us. you might return your november list and offering at masses, at the parish office, or at the box at the sacr ed space in the cathedral. in this sacred space will be the names of a ll those who passed away over the past 12 months mass intentions for 2027 for your planning, please note that bookings for 1st anniversary masses only will be taken at the parish office on tuesday, 27th october . all other mass intentions can be arranged from wednesday, 28th october onwards. please call to the parish office only on those days. no bookings will be taken over the phone that week. october awareness month week iv setting sail (those discerning) "st. brendan untied the rope." not remaining on the shore, he knew every vocation begins with trust. god does not reveal the whole journey. only the next faithfu l step. those discerning trust the road ahead. --------------------------------------------------- --------------------------------------- killarney national park — autumn talk series : on thursday , 29th october 8:00pm, killarney house & gardens “exploring the annuals of innisfallen” speaker: pádraig ó macháin, professor of modern irish, ucc . admission is free. seating is limited. a livestreaming service is avai lable via the facebook page, @killarneynationalpark. killarney community college foundation bingo , wed nov 11th @7.30pm at the school. guaranteed jackpot of €500. all welcome ballymacelligott

masses and intentions this week sat 24th oct beaufort 7.30pm maisie foley, brookhill. sun 25th oct beaufort 10am michael doona, carnahone 1st anniversary. thurs 29th oct valley 7.30pm for the special intentions of the people of the black valley. sat 31st oct beaufort 7.30pm catherine & john mangan and their son michael & all the deceased members of the mangan family, ardlahas. and dan & deb o shea, mealis sun 1st nov beaufort 10am all saints. jeremiah & maureen o sullivan, meanus. and annette murphy, cullina upper. we remember in our prayers eileen crehan (mother of kieran crehan), lackabane, killarney who passed away during the week. eternal rest grant unto her soul, o lord. autumn offering due at this time. many thanks for your generous support during the year. priest on duty: sat 24th/sun 25th oct - fr kieran
